name: GenericSubdomain
summary: A cohesive part of the model that is necessary and in no way distinctive — every organisation in the field needs it, and none competes on it.

roles.name: GenericSubdomain
roles.summary: A part of the model that could be bought, outsourced or replaced by a published solution without weakening what the organisation is good at. Saying so is what keeps modelling effort away from it.
